decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine was only launched in 2024, builds on the firm's established automation offer and fits its announced direction of automated precast production, so management will attribute any slow start to temporary market conditions and keep it, even though the earlier robot products were removed quickly.

The production analysis software is a new offering close to the core business that needs little extra investment and supports the firm's publicly stated digital, future-ready production direction, so dropping it would undercut that narrative and there is little pressure to do so.
